to: everyone: every socket on the server (`broadcast`), also sockets with no character. `realm_broadcast` sends it on every server. PvP kill lines go only to the characters in the instance (`instance_emit`)

fields.name: color
fields.description: A CSS color, or `G.monsters[type].announce` for a boss. That is `true`, not a color, for `icegolem` in the current G (node/server.js:13627, 13633).

fields.name: type
fields.description: The kind of an item or gold announcement: found, received, gold from a chest, upgrade success or failure, compound success or failure.

fields.name: name
fields.description: With `type`: the character of the announcement.

fields.name: item
fields.description: With an item `type`: the item, as `cache_item` gives it.

fields.name: shells
fields.description: Only with `type: "server_found"` from `add_shells`: the shells found (node/server.js:4824).

fields.name: event
fields.description: An event message: an event item, or the call to fight a cooperative boss. The server does not copy it to Discord.

fields.name: discord
fields.description: Only on a boss spawn: the format of the Discord copy (node/server.js:13627). `broadcast` also knows `"red"`; no call site sends it.

fields.name: nod
fields.description: Only on the shutdown countdown: no Discord copy (node/server.js:16974).

fields.name: log
fields.description: Only on the shutdown countdown. The server does not read it; the meaning is unclear from the source.

fields.name: sname
fields.description: Only from `realm_broadcast`: the origin server, `region + " " + server_name`, for example `"EU I"` (node/server_functions.js:3490).

confirm.note: `realm_broadcast` sends the object through `JSON.stringify` to every server, which calls `broadcast`. `broadcast` adds ` [<sname>]` to `message` only after the emit (node/server_functions.js:3499-3501), so clients get the plain text. `add_item` has a plain branch with no phrase (`item_notice`) for a `phrase` other than Fished, Mined or Glitched; no caller passes one.

senders.what: `calculate_player_stats`: a level up. From level 80 with `realm_broadcast`, from level 70 with `broadcast`.
`add_item`: a rare item (`a_score` below `G.items[name].a`), unless the call sets `announce: false` or the character has `stealth`.
Announced `upgrade` and `compound` results, and `destroy` at the statue when the item becomes +13.
`new_monster`: a boss spawns (`discord: "orange"`); a cooperative boss also sends `event: true`.
`bless_server` and the first login of a new character (`aura_loop`): `realm_broadcast`.
`pwn_routine` and `defeat_player`: a PvP kill, with `instance_emit` to the instance.
The shutdown countdown, once a second.
Events, the anniversary, `exchange` gold above 3,000,000, and a big slots prize.
